hero.subtitle: YOUR PRIVATE REFUGE IN JUQUEHY
hero.title: Vila Dolores
hero.headline_2: comfort of home, practicality of a loft
hero.quote: "In the 80s, our grandmother Dolores brought us to Juquehy for the first time. Back then, the beach was a well-kept secret, with few houses and residents. Decades later, we transformed that memory into a space that celebrates warmth and family time, making those who stay here feel at home, even when away from home."

about.title: HOUSE APARTMENTS
about.desc_1: Vila Dolores is an exclusive collection of four house apartments that combine the comfort and privacy of a home with the practicality and functionality of a modern loft.
about.desc_2: Each unit has been carefully designed to offer spacious, fully equipped, and welcoming environments that balance design and coziness, ideal for those seeking days of rest and fun with family or friends.
about.desc_3: Check "Our Villas" to find the ideal configuration for you!
about.beach_desc_1: With over 3 km in length, Juquehy features a wide strip of fine white sand, transparent blue waters, and a sunset that invites you to stay on the beach.
about.beach_desc_2: From surfing to the tranquility of a delightful sea bath, the beach also attracts athletes who enjoy running, playing ball, frescobol, and cycling.
about.beach_desc_3: A family-friendly environment that will enchant you!

accommodations_intro.title: See which accommodation is ideal for you!
accommodations_intro.description: Explore the amenities and layouts of our units. Each offers a unique space for you to relax and enjoy special moments. Discover the facilities and cozy environments we have prepared for you. Browse the photo gallery and find the perfect place for your stay.

location.title: PRIME LOCATION
location.description_1: Vila Dolores is located just 500 meters from the beach at entrance 4, and two blocks from the commercial center, steps away from everything you need.
location.description_2: Supermarkets, exquisite restaurants, premium ice cream parlors, bakeries, pharmacies, and shopping centers—all accessible without leaving the garage.

areia.name: Areia
areia.short_desc: Cozy and practical — perfect for smaller families.
areia.full_desc: Casa Areia, located on the ground floor, offers the perfect convenience for those who want to arrive from the beach, quickly settle in, and enjoy the environment without climbing stairs. The integrated small backyard brings a breath of fresh air and practicality, ideal for relaxing moments after a swim in the sea.

list.room: 1 bedroom with 2 single beds and integrated bathroom
list.living: Open concept dining and living room, double sofa bed and connected TV
list.kitchen: Kitchen equipped with cooktop, refrigerator, microwave and utensils for 6 guests

areia.footer: Perfect for those who want to arrive, settle in properly and enjoy the sea without worries.

mare.name: Maré
mare.short_desc: Ample space with a private gourmet patio — to enjoy after the beach.
mare.full_desc: Casa Maré is the ground floor villa that elevates the living experience. The great differentiator is its private gourmet patio featuring a BBQ grill and an exclusive outdoor shower. It is the definitive environment for barbecues, laughter, and great outdoor moments with those you love, uniting the functionality of the interior with the delight of the outdoor area.

list.room: 1 bedroom with double bed + single bed and integrated bathroom
list.living: Open concept dining and living room, double sofa bed and connected TV
list.kitchen: Kitchen equipped with cooktop, refrigerator, microwave and utensils for 7 guests
list.patio: Private gourmet patio with BBQ grill

mare.footer: The perfect environment for barbecues, laughter and good times outdoors.

horizonte.name: Horizonte
horizonte.short_desc: More space across 2 floors, enhanced comfort, and a private gourmet solarium.
horizonte.full_desc: Casa Horizonte offers the refinement of a duplex residence. On the upper floor, you will enjoy a spacious mezzanine that serves as a second living area. The highlight of the villa is the impressive 20m² gourmet solarium, ensuring total privacy to enjoy the freedom of your own rooftop, day or night.

list.room: 1 bedroom with 2 single beds and integrated bathroom
list.living: Open concept dining and living room and double sofa bed
list.mezzanine: Mezzanine with connected TV and double sofa bed
list.kitchen: Kitchen equipped with cooktop, refrigerator, microwave and utensils for 8 guests

horizonte.footer: The ideal space for those who want comfort and the freedom to enjoy day and night on their own rooftop.

brisa.name: Brisa
brisa.short_desc: The same structure and charm as Casa Horizonte, featuring a private gourmet solarium.
brisa.full_desc: Casa Brisa mirrors the stunning architecture of Casa Horizonte. With spaces divided over two floors, it possesses the charm of the mezzanine and the luxury of the 20m² private gourmet solarium. It is the ideal space for larger families or groups of friends who do not compromise on comfort, fresh breezes, and an exclusive rooftop in Juquehy.
